external_sources.title: OpenStax Biology 2e: ecology and biogeochemical cycles
external_sources.content: OpenStax Biology 2e Sections 44.1, 44.3, 44.4, 46.1 and 46.3 provide open educational explanations of ecology, terrestrial and aquatic biomes, ecosystem structure, energy transfer and biogeochemical cycles. This package uses newly written explanations and examples aligned to those concepts; it does not reproduce OpenStax passages or figures.

evidence.explanation: Supports the original explanations of habitats, ecosystem components, energy flow, nutrient cycling, ecological disturbance and adaptation context.

external_sources.rights: OpenStax Biology 2e is published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; this package uses original paraphrased teaching and attribution, not copied figures.
